snippet.title: Wrack Remake - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Inspired by classics like DOOM and Quake, Wrack is an arcade-style FPS. Mow down enemies one after another, and become more powerful the more you kill. Amass a deadly arsenal, discover secret powers... and save your world!

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3709080/Wrack_Remake/

Coming to Steam and Nintendo Switch in 2025.
